plan.summary: DIR-016 nav restoration. ROOT CAUSE verified from real route tables: (A) ENTERPRISE_TABS has 13 tabs but EnterpriseConsole.jsx NAVIGATION renders 14 - platform (platformOnly:true) has no Cuba nav entry, so the org sidebar omits the Provisioning Console; the old test only walked nav-to-console so the omission was silent. (B) CANDIDATE_NAVIGATION has 13 items but DashboardMain.jsx mounts Route path=favorites to DashboardFavourites, so /dashboard/favorites is unreachable from the Cuba sidebar and palette. FIX: add platform tab with platformOnly to ENTERPRISE_TABS and ENTERPRISE_GROUPS; carry platformOnly through enterpriseNavigationFor; extend filterByPermissions with a fail-closed platformAdmin option (INV-3); wire the server-derived platformAdmin from useEnterpriseTenant in EnterprisePortalCuba using wildcard grants so all existing tab visibility stays byte-identical and ONLY platform is gated; add platform icon to ICON_MAP; restore favorites to the workspace group and merge item.keywords into CANDIDATE_COMMAND_INDEX while keeping item.to; add bi-directional parity tests in both suites with alias and showcase routes explicitly classified; author playwright.dir016.config.js plus tests/e2e/dir016-omitted-surfaces.spec.js against the live stack. BASELINE VERIFIED BEFORE ANY EDIT: frozen diff vs e314f715 = 0 bytes (INV-1); enterprise+candidate suites 64/64 pass.
